[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Sarev''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was assigned to lead [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lasre Dardano]]'s secret listening post, [[Whisper Base]], in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. When a group of [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] personnel breached the base's command center, he fled in the base's [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] to try to contact the Moff and was pursued by the Rebels.

==Behind the scenes==
Sarev appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''. The players must battle him, and the result of the battle is they prevent him from contacting the Moff or he succeeds in doing so.
